checks.criterion: The selected child age band carries into the lesson page
checks.name: age-band-carries-into-lesson
checks.evidence: Selected Ages 6–8 in Chill & Learn setup, built lesson: lesson-age-band badge showed 'Ages 6–8'. Played then paused the real video via the native element; pause-discuss-modal text contained 'Ages 6–8' confirming the age band flows into the pause question too.

checks.criterion: Lesson content uses real playable open demo video
checks.name: lesson-video-real-playable
checks.evidence: lesson-video element currentSrc contained 'flower.webm' (MDN CC0 clip), had a native controls attribute, and requestFullscreen was a function. After play(), el.paused became false and currentTime advanced by >0.3s; real-video-timestamp text moved off '00:00'.

checks.criterion: Questions stay hidden during active playback
checks.name: questions-hidden-during-playback
checks.evidence: pause-discuss-modal had count 0 before playback started, and remained count 0 while video.paused was false and currentTime was actively advancing (>0.3s in).

checks.criterion: Pausing creates one age-adjusted thought-provoking question
checks.name: pause-creates-one-thought-provoking-question
checks.evidence: Selected Ages 9–10, played then paused the video: exactly 1 pause-discuss-modal appeared, pause-discuss-title read 'Pause & Think', and modal text contained both 'THOUGHT-PROVOKING' and 'Ages 9–10'.

checks.criterion: The adult can mark a pause question Answered
checks.name: answered-button-marks-and-increments-count
checks.evidence: answered-count started at '0 answered'; answered-question-button text changed from 'Answered' to 'Answered ✓' on click; after Continue Watching, answered-count updated to '1 answered'.

checks.criterion: Continue Watching resumes the real video
checks.name: continue-watching-resumes-real-video
checks.evidence: After pausing and recording currentTime, clicking continue-watching-button closed the modal, video.paused became false again, and currentTime advanced past the pre-pause value by >0.3s.

checks.criterion: Watch Together offers a broad genre showcase
checks.name: watch-together-broad-genre-chips
checks.evidence: custom-preference-horror and custom-preference-action chips are visible and selectable (class toggled to selected border-violet state); added participant tscheck-genre-fan card text contained both 'Horror' and 'Action'. Catalogue source (chill-data.ts) has 34 seeded titles spanning comedy/horror/action/sci-fi/romance/thriller/animation/documentary/educational/family genres.

checks.criterion: Expanded Watch Together recommendations remain explainable
checks.name: couple-thrilling-expanded-recommendations
checks.evidence: Couple + Thrilling mood + 90–120 min duration returned 12 content-card-title-* cards (>=10). Combined content-card-meta-* text across cards contained both 'Horror' and 'Action'. First card's content-card-match-* showed 'Group Match'; opening why-this-* showed why-modal with why-modal-score containing 'Group Match' plus per-member reasoning.
